title: New Customer shows Credit Terms and Credit Limit, prefilled with the default
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is the default for new customers.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-01 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens. The window shows a "Credit Terms" dropdown and a "Credit Limit" field side by side, in the same place they sit on Edit Customer. Credit Terms already reads {Term-A}, with a "Default" tag after the name, and Credit Limit is editable.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S5-R1: “New Customer shows a "Credit Terms" dropdown and a "Credit Limit" field side by side, in the same place they sit on Edit Customer.”
  • S5-R2: “On New Customer, Credit Terms is prefilled with the shop's default.”
  • S5-R3: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Customer and Edit Customer lists the shop's active terms in the S1-R5 order. The default carries a "Default" tag after its name.”
  • S11-R5: “New Customer now shows Credit Terms (prefilled with the default, COD for existing shops) and Credit Limit to users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'. Users without it see New Customer as before.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “The Credit Terms and Credit Limit fields on New Customer and Edit Customer, and the Credit Terms field on New Vendor and Edit Vendor, are governed by 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', as the existing Edit fields are.”
  • Goals: “Creating a customer on a non-default term takes zero extra screens: the term is set on New Customer itself.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer today", "New Customer: Credit Terms prefilled with the default"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p5-01-new-customer-today.png
  • ct-p5-02-new-customer-credit-terms-prefilled-with-the-def.png

The design's own words:

  • “For a user with View and Manage AP/AR Data. Credit Terms is filled in with the shop default (here Due on Receipt) and can be changed before saving.”
  • “Credit Limit now sits beside it, as on Edit Customer, and starts blank (blank means no limit). Same gate as Credit Terms: View and Manage AP/AR Data.”
